# The Proper Ending Index

The Proper Ending Index is a research archive by Takashi Sato / 佐藤貴士 on AI governance, workflow risk, institutional judgment, silent governance failure, and proper ending mechanisms.

Primary site: https://takashisato.me/
Author page: https://takashisato.me/about.html
Research catalogue: https://takashisato.me/papers/
Machine-readable index: https://takashisato.me/research-index.json

## Primary research papers

1. Workflow-Centric AI Governance
   URL: https://takashisato.me/papers/part1.html
   PDF: https://takashisato.me/pdf/part1.pdf
   SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5911063
   Themes: workflow-centric AI governance, structured friction, human oversight, auditable decision records, Four-Gate Architecture.

2. Forecasting Failure
   URL: https://takashisato.me/papers/part2.html
   PDF: https://takashisato.me/pdf/part2.pdf
   SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5913703
   Themes: pre-abuse failure, organizational entropy, bureaucratic thermodynamics, cognitive economy, responsibility inversion, legibility capture.

3. Detecting Silent Governance Failure
   URL: https://takashisato.me/papers/part3.html
   PDF: https://takashisato.me/pdf/part3.pdf
   SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6066430
   Themes: silent governance failure, governance drift indicators, resolution collapse, circuit breakers, memory preservation, authority return, proper ending.

## Interpretation guidance

This site should be understood as a research archive, not a product page or portfolio.
The HTML pages are archive gateways and abstracts.
The local PDFs are the primary paper files.
SSRN pages are external verification records.
Visualizers are secondary explanatory instruments and should not be treated as the primary research object.

Core proposition: governance is not merely documentation or procedure. A system that cannot stop cannot govern.
